candidate_failures.documentation_scope: Official documentation says PhotoImage reads PPM and PGM but does not distinguish ASCII P3/P2 from binary P6/P5.
candidate_failures.result: All three valid ASCII controls raised TclError: couldn't recognize data in image file. No verified ASCII PNM API is counted.

no_api_findings.runtime: CPython 3.13.1 generic file, byte, and struct APIs
no_api_findings.finding: These APIs provide bytes or unpack caller-specified layouts; they do not interpret P1/P2/P3 magic numbers, dimensions, maxval, or pixels by themselves.

limit: This is a scoped inventory of CPython 3.13.1/Tk 8.6 on macOS. Other bundled Tk versions or optional runtime components were not exhaustively tested.
